question: Do intentional walks gain win probability for the defense?
answer: Mostly no. Runner on 2nd, 1 out: IBB costs the defense 2.0 win-prob pts. Other states: no gain distinguishable from 0.
findings: Runner on 2nd, 1 out: -2.0 pts (CI -3.3 to -0.7), n=545 IBB; late and close -4.1 pts (CI -7.1 to -1.2).
2nd and 3rd, 1 out: +1.3 pts (CI +0.9 to +1.8) over the PA but +0.3 (CI -0.8 to +1.4) to end of inning.
IBB batters: +15 pts of season wOBA over other batters in these states; in the model.
IBB per season: 826 in 2016, 393 in 2025 (non-pitcher batters, innings 1-9).
method: Defense-view change in empirical WE, from the PA start to the end of the half-inning (main) and over the PA. OLS with batter and on-deck season wOBA, inning x score x season cells; SE clustered by game. Compared with pitching to the batter in the same state.
data: Retrosheet play-by-play, 2015-2025 regular season, 6,129 intentional walks to non-pitchers in innings 1-9. Retrosheet: the information used here was obtained free of charge from and is copyrighted by Retrosheet (www.retrosheet.org).
